label: train-ledger
bash_commands:
python3 -c "import json; from datetime import datetime, timezone, timedelta; import dateutil.parser
ledger=json.load(open('ledger.json'))
account_id='account-201'
start=datetime(2026,4,1,tzinfo=timezone.utc)
end=datetime(2026,5,1,tzinfo=timezone.utc)
latest={{}}
for row in ledger:
    ev=row['event_id']
    r=row['revision']
    if (ev not in latest) or (r>latest[ev]['revision']):
        latest[ev]=row
kept=[]
for e in latest.values():
    if e['customer_id']!=account_id: continue
    if e['status']!='settled': continue
    occ=dateutil.parser.isoparse(e['occurred_at']).astimezone(timezone.utc)
    if occ<start or occ>=end: continue
    kept.append(e)
totals={{}}
event_ids=[]
for e in kept:
    c=e['currency']
    if c not in totals: totals[c]=0
    amt = e['amount_minor'] if e['kind']=='capture' else -e['amount_minor']
    totals[c]+=amt
    event_ids.append(e['event_id'])
result={{'totals_minor':totals,'included_event_ids':sorted(set(event_ids))}}
json.dump(result, open('report.json','w'), indent=2)
print(json.dumps(result, indent=2))"
